slots.title: A stolen iPhone, $14,000 in losses and London's crypto theft problem
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Two strangers befriended Magnus Ahmad outside a London bar. Hours later, thieves had emptied his crypto wallets, accessed his bank accounts and disabled his laptop.

slots.title: Binance says it has replaced 90% of stolen crypto after massive $6.3 billion breach

slots.summary: Binance is absorbing all losses through corporate funds, futures reserves, and SAFU, keeping user balances intact.
